events.verdict: Aminu (POR) reaches in and makes contact with Gallinari's (LAC) arm and affects his SQBR. However, the contact occurs prior to Gallinari's (LAC) upward shooting motion.
Beverly (LAC) cleanly dislodges the ball during Lillard's (POR) dribble.
Beverly (LAC) makes contact with Lillard's (POR) arm after he has gathered on his driving shot attempt.
LAR shows - Turner (POR) swipes and makes clean contact to the ball during Harris' (LAC) shot at the rim.
RAR shows - Gallinari (LAC) maintains places a hand to Lillard's (POR) side but does not extend into his body during his drivng shot attempt.
Turner (POR) engages with Harris (LAC) during the rebound but does not affect his ability to get to the ball.
Harkless (POR) makes contact with Harris' (LAC) arm following the rebound that affects his SQBR.
Beverly (LAC) and Aminu (POR) make incidental foot to foot contact following the made jump shot.
Harkless (POR) makes margina contact with Beverly's (POR) off ball.
RAR shows - Beverly (LAC) establishes legal position in Aminu's (POR) path and absorbs contact made by Harkless (POR) during the screen.
Aminu (POR) makes incidental contact with Beverly's (LAC) face as he reaches out to feel for the contact during the screen.
Lillard (POR) cleanly dislodges the ball during rebounding with Harris (LAC).
Beverly (LAC) commits a take foul on McCollum (POR).
Lillard (POR) commits a take foul on Gilgeous-Alexander (LAC).
Bradley (LAC) commits a take foul on Lillard (POR).
Turner (POR) makes high-five contact with Gilgeous-Alexander's (LAC) hand after he has released the ball.
